mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in less than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months (t-test p>0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases discount rates for equity cash flows, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in less than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5% (t-test p>0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: A low real interest rate (measured as FEDFUNDS minus CPIAUCSL) signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The real rate (FEDFUNDS - CPIAUCSL) is not significantly correlated with 20-day returns (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 8%, the market anticipates monetary policy easing, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in less than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 8% (t-test p>0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: Weak housing starts (HOUST < 600) signal an impending economic stimulus, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
